curation.notes: Custom single-beam optical trap (fixed-trap stall and AOD force-feedback assays) on human kinesin-1 (full-length KIF5B and K560) walking on sea urchin sperm axonemes, comparing a conventional high z-force geometry (bead directly on motor) with a low z-force geometry using a long lambda-DNA handle; multi-motor experiments use 2- and 3-motor DNA chassis. TIRF motility assays and mass photometry are complementary.

evidence.snippet: In all measurements, the bead position was acquired at 5 kHz, and the motor concentration was reduced until less than 30% of beads demonstrated motility within 100 s

hardware.calibration_notes: PSD response calibrated by raster scanning trapped beads with AODs; stiffness from Lorentzian fit of power spectrum.

evidence.snippet: A 20 W, 1064 nm ytterbium linear polarized CW laser (IPG Photonics) was used to trap beads.

laser_power_at_source.note: nominal laser rating; power adjusted with motorized half-wave plate

evidence.snippet: A 20 W, 1064 nm ytterbium linear polarized CW laser (IPG Photonics) was used to trap beads.

trap_stiffness.note: single motor; 0.1 pN/nm for two motors and 0.2 pN/nm for three motors

evidence.snippet: In fixed trap assays, typical trap stiffnesses were 0.08–0.10 pN/nm for single motor, 0.1 pN/nm for two motors, and 0.2 pN/nm for three motors.
The desired force was achieved by tuning the trap stiffness accordingly, and the trap position was updated at 100 Hz.

bead_size.note: 860 nm beads (Spherotech) for K560 and multi-motor chassis; 510 nm beads (Bangs Labs) for full-length KIF5B with DNA handle

evidence.snippet: When trapping single K560 motors, biotinylated K560 was added to 0.2% w/v 860-nm-diameter streptavidin-functionalized polystyrene beads (Spherotech) for 10 min.

attachment_chemistry: DNA hybridization (handle overhang to motor oligo)

handle_sequences.annotations: A PCR reaction was performed with 2 μl of 500 μg/mL lambda phage DNA (NEB), 15 μL each of Bio Forward and Kinesin Reverse primers (Table 1)

evidence.snippet: Human full-length (ZZ-KIF5B-GFP-SNAP) and truncated (ZZ-KIF5B(1-560)-GFP-SNAP) kinesin-1 plasmids were encoded into a pOmnibac backbone

entities.name: Long dsDNA handle (lambda DNA PCR, 5'-biotin, ligated ssDNA overhang)

evidence.snippet: Here, we substantially lowered the z-force by using a long DNA handle between the motor and the trapped bead

entities.name: DNA chassis for two- and three-motor assemblies

evidence.snippet: Four versions of the DNA chassis were used for multiple motor experiments.
Axonemes purified from sea urchin sperm were used as microtubule tracks to assay for motility.

solution.notes: For multi-motor measurements MBC and SB additionally contained 100 mM NaCl and 1 mg/mL BSA.

evidence.snippet: Axonemes were diluted 1:10 in motor buffer (MB: 30 mM HEPES, 5 mM MgSO4, 1 mM EGTA, 10% glycerol, pH 7.4) for 3 min. The chamber was then washed with MBC (MB supplemented with 1.25 mg/mL casein and 1 mM DTT).
